c1.text: Why does the Sun turn red in the evening?

g2.text: At noon, sunlight comes straight down.
In the evening it slants: a long trip through air.

g3.text: On the way the blue is lost, red-orange is left.

c2.text: So the blue got off on the way!

c3.text: What colour is a sunset on Mars?

c4.text: why does the Moon follow us?
